title: Which coffee order are you?
intro: Six questions about mornings, weekends and small rituals. We'll pour you the drink that matches your personality.

outcomes.name: Espresso
outcomes.tagline: Short, intense, already halfway through the to-do list.
outcomes.description: You know what you want and you don't waste time getting it. People admire your focus, even if they occasionally wish you'd sit down for a second. You'd rather do one thing brilliantly than five things fine.

outcomes.name: Oat Latte
outcomes.tagline: Warm, easygoing and everyone's favourite company.
outcomes.description: You make every room a little cosier. You remember birthdays, you bring snacks, and you're happy to go with the flow as long as the flow involves good conversation and a comfy chair.

outcomes.name: Cold Brew
outcomes.description: You take your time and it shows: steady, unflappable and surprisingly powerful once you get going. You're the friend people call in a crisis because nothing seems to rattle you.

outcomes.name: Matcha
outcomes.tagline: Curious, particular, and proudly a little different.
outcomes.description: Technically not coffee, and that's exactly the point. You like rituals, details and things with a story behind them. You'd rather find something special than follow the crowd.

outcomes.name: Pumpkin Spice
outcomes.description: You go all in on whatever makes you happy and you don't care who's rolling their eyes. Seasonal decorations, theme parties, matching outfits: life is more fun with a bit of extra.

questions.text: Your alarm goes off. What happens next?

answers.text: Up immediately. The day has started.
Snooze once, then a slow stretch.
I woke up before it anyway.
I put on a playlist that matches my mood.
Brunch with the whole group chat
A long walk somewhere I've never been
Finally finishing a big project
Doing absolutely nothing, gloriously

questions.text: A friend is having a rough day. You…

answers.text: Turn up with snacks and a blanket
Make a plan to fix the problem
Listen, and stay calm for both of you
Drag them out for something silly and fun

questions.text: Which shop could you spend an hour in?

answers.text: A tiny independent stationery shop
A seasonal pop-up full of decorations
A bookshop with armchairs
None. I'm in and out in five minutes.
Spotless, except for the current task
Plants, a candle and a nice notebook
Covered in stickers and little figurines
A mug, a cardigan and three half-read books

questions.text: Someone recommends a new café. You…

answers.text: Go tomorrow and order the weirdest thing on the menu
Go if it's on the way and it's quick
Invite three friends and make an afternoon of it
Add it to the list. I'll get there eventually.
